$comment: Figma↔code mapping for published component sets. The counterpart of design/tokens.json, which does the same job for variables. Component sets are named for how they read on canvas, not mechanically, so this file is what makes non-obvious pairings (Buttons → Button.astro, curiosity → CuriosityRow.astro) safe to rely on. Each component file also opens with a comment naming its set and node id, so the mapping is discoverable from either end.

sets.notes: The matrix is sparse in Figma and sparse in code — only the five combinations above exist. State is a CSS :hover, not a prop. Renders <a> when href is present, <button type="button"> otherwise.

Named ChatBubble because the set draws one bubble, not the thread. Figma gives request/text and request/selection a single style branch, so the component does too. The :hover on request is not in the design — it is pre-existing behaviour carried over from src/pages/index.astro. --size-chat-choice (400px) is unbound in Figma.

Named Avatar because `user` collides with the prop it takes. `user="max"` is a code-side addition: the Figma set has no max variant, and public/avatars/max.svg is byte-equivalent artwork to the logo set's mark. `all` resolves to /avatars/everyone.svg — the asset predates the Figma variant name.
Three separate assets, not one recolourable SVG: both the circular ground and the base rectangle recolour between variants. chat/tomato and chat/herbs have no exported file in the repo yet.

Two icons only. cursor (109:1373) is 40×40 and already ships as public/cursor.svg; figma-make (140:1095) is 80×80 and has no exported file yet. Scope boundary: the eight marks inside the NavBar frame are NOT part of this set — they are footer data in src/config/site.ts. Separately, public/cursor-pointer.svg (16×16) has NO Figma node: it is the same circle re-drawn at pointer size for the site-wide CSS cursor, because a url() cursor renders at the asset's intrinsic size and CSS cannot scale it. The 40×40 mark here is unchanged and is what /styleguide renders. Change the colour and both files need it.

The dot is the matching colour ramp's 500 step. Each variant carries its own rotation angle on canvas; the exact four angles are not yet transcribed and the component currently ships unrotated. There is no angle token tier and there should not be one — they belong in the component as commented literals.

The drawn states became a `state` prop, and client JS toggles them. The back face is a playground card and maps to the playground collection in src/content.config.ts. The design defines no motion, so the state swaps instantly — a flip animation would be invented. With JS blocked the prop is what renders and the buttons are inert.

Named CuriosityRow because the set is one row, not the section. It is an Avatar beside a ChatBubble type="message" and nothing more, so the component composes those two rather than restyling either. Maps to the curiosity collection (thought + question).

The frame's copy ("Let's be honest") is final in Max's voice, not placeholder, so it is the prop default. Body arrives through the default slot because the source is markdown in collection frontmatter.

Renders one position. Mirrors the resume collection in src/content.config.ts. The date range is formatted by src/lib/dates.ts formatRange; the hyphen-minus in "Mar - Oct 2026" is the design's glyph, not an en dash.

exploded/small does not exist. Props are presentation-level rather than schema-level because the page decides which projects fields feed them. The decorative paper-scrap collage is absolutely-positioned aria-hidden geometry with no token — its per-scrap offsets, sizes and rotations are not yet transcribed, so the collage does not render yet.

Six columns of tiles, as drawn. No content collection exists for tools, so /styleguide passes placeholders. An entry with no icon renders the empty tile the design already draws, with its name as the visible label.
The tomato dot is a ::before disc, not a ::marker — ::marker colour is not reliably settable. No content collection exists, so /styleguide passes placeholders.

Renders ONE note, not the feed. The design's third section label is `tools`, which is why the prop is; the releaseNotes schema field is `tech`, so the `tools:` key in src/content/release-notes/2026-08-17.md frontmatter is silently dropped by Zod today. That is a content-field rename, out of scope here. The inactive greys are token-chosen, not transcribed.

Renders ONE case-study section, not the whole study. Mirrors caseSection in src/content.config.ts. The frame's prose is lorem ipsum, so /styleguide passes bracketed copy. The frame binds a stray variable `Sizes/L: 24` that sits outside the seven real collections and is already marked for deletion; it has no CSS token, and --space-md is 24px. The inactive greys are token-chosen, not transcribed.

Named NavBar in Figma but reads as the site footer: legal link, an "explore with" credit, seven section links and five social marks. Mode is a ground colour per instance, NOT a colour scheme — no prefers-color-scheme block. The label prop exists so two instances on /styleguide do not trip unique-landmark. Its links live in src/config/site.ts as NAV, SOCIALS and EXPLORE_WITH, all dummy routes. Below 48rem the outer row stacks; the Figma Mobile frame (103:1103) is empty, so that one decision is undesigned.

unbound.$comment: Values the design uses that no Figma variable holds. Each is a literal in code with a comment saying so. Listed here so the next sync can see them without re-reading the file.
items: --size-chat-choice (400px) — the max-width on four of the five Chat combinations.
The explore-with marks' drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgb(240 229 17 / 0.25)) in NavBar — not an Elevation style.
w-[383.108px] on the NavBar impressum column — a magic number, dropped in code.
The project preview paper-scrap collage geometry.
Sizes/L: 24 in project sections — a stray variable outside the seven collections, already marked for deletion.

outstanding.$comment: Work this port could not finish because the Figma MCP server was unreachable on 2026-08-29: mcp.figma.com returned 401 Unauthorized, no Figma desktop app was installed to host the local server, and no API token was available. Every item below needs one Figma read or write and nothing else. Nothing here was guessed at — the code omits these values rather than inventing them.
variableWrites: Typography collection is missing font/weight/bold = 700, line-height/none = 1 and line-height/relaxed = 1.4. All three already exist in src/styles/tokens.css and design/tokens.json, so the three-file rule is two-thirds done. Each needs a value, a description, scopes, and WEB code syntax (var(--font-weight-bold), var(--line-height-none), var(--line-height-relaxed)) — without the code syntax the MCP emits var(--line-height\/none), which is not valid CSS. The collection has one mode, named Value.

Re-bind the text styles that still hold raw numbers: Typography/H1–H5 → line-height/none; Typography/Body - Small and Typography/Captions → line-height/relaxed. Until then get_variable_defs reports floats instead of names.
assetExports: 114:204 → public/icons/explore-3.svg — layer name is `image 4 [Vectorized]` and the brand is not identifiable at 16px. Rendered decoratively (alt="") on purpose; ask before naming it.

108:1371 → public/favicon.svg — diff against the committed file before overwriting. The committed one appears to carry a tomato-100 ground while the Figma Type=favicon variant draws a near-white one. If they differ the Figma file wins, and BaseLayout wires this as the browser icon.
geometryReads: post-it (114:581) — the four per-variant rotation angles. Write each as a rotate(Ndeg) literal with a comment; there is no angle token tier and adding one would be inventing a tier.

project preview (114:646) — the decorative paper-scrap collage: per-scrap offsets, sizes and rotations, plus what the exploded state moves. The component currently renders no scraps, so `exploded` has no visual expression and is observable only through data-state and aria-pressed.
unverifiedChoices: Every spacing gap marked `token-chosen, not Figma-read` in the component sources — ToolBox grid and tile gaps, FocusAreas list and marker gaps, CuriosityRow avatar gap, CvSection role/company and project-row gaps, BlankSection body gap.

The inactive greys in ReleaseNote and ProjectSection. Picked as --color-neutral-700 for text (7.91:1 on neutral-100) and --color-neutral-600 for frames (3.40:1, clearing the 3:1 non-text bar) rather than by eye.
NavBar mode=default ground = --color-neutral-100. Only the dark ground was transcribed.

The five inferred rows in the /styleguide text-style table: Typography/Body, Body - Large, Body - Bold, Mono and Captions. They are derived from component usage, marked as inferred on the page, and still need confirming.
NavBar .navbar__nav flex-wrap: wrap. Not in the design — added because .navbar clips and a narrow viewport was silently cutting #aboutme and #behindthescenes off the right edge.
ToolBox drops 6 columns to 2 below 48rem. A second undesigned mobile decision beyond the NavBar one.
